# High tap coverage under Jal Jeevan scheme, but lower usage, reliability

## Water flowed through taps in only 83% of households, and only 76% had water that met standards for e-coli, faecal coliform, pH levels

Published - January 30, 2026 10:00 pm IST - NEW DELHI [...] THe scheme originally aimed for 100% coverage and functionality by 2024 but this has now been extended to 2028. With about 81% coverage as of the latest estimates, the remaining 20% requires nearly ₹4 lakh crore, nearly as much as the ₹3.6 lakh crore that was spent since 2019, officials had told The Hindu last February.
